title.narrative: Palestinian Expenditure and Consumption Survey (PECS) 2023/2025

description.narrative: The overall objectives for this action are to have an updated detailed database and indicators about Palestinians levels of living that will assist in planning and policy making at all. To know the consumption expenditure patterns and the impact of social variables on them, such as educational, social and other levels, and finally to monitor and evaluate poverty percentage. It will entails: facilitating the field implementation of the PECS survey, supporting the training of the field workers at Governorates level and contributing to the dissemination of results and visibility actions.
